description: On launch the game shows a title card ('First steps. Real jumps.') with ENTER/START button; ENTER or clicking the button starts the run. Pause card ('Take a breath.'), completion card ('Course complete.' with time/retries/coins/rank) reuse the same card layout.

A/Left and D/Right move, Space jumps, Esc/P pauses, R retries the attempt, Enter confirms/starts/resumes, M returns to menu (from pause or completion); left-click on the on-screen START button also starts/resumes. Bindings registered at runtime in _setup_input.

18x28 CharacterBody2D collider; speed 160 px/s with accel/decel, jump velocity -320, gravity 960, 6-tick coyote and 6-tick input buffer; exactly one jump per floor contact, held jump does not re-fire; animation is presentation-only (idle/walk/run/jump/celebrate/error).

The x 0-960 tutorial yard (two steps, 64px and 48px gaps, one 24px spike bed, world labels) is preserved from the original slice; its solid/hazard/spawn entries carry identical values into the extended JSON (file was reformatted to single line; finish moved 916 -> 1884).
23 gold coins placed in arcs and risk/reward spots; touching one collects it (Area2D overlap, +1 to the run total, coin hides); HUD shows live count; coins bob gently in place.

3 orange '?' blocks at x 960-1048; they are solid; jumping so the head hits the block from below (is_on_ceiling + head-rect overlap) spends the block once, pays +1 coin, dims the block, and plays a '+1' float-up pop animation.

One hidden block at x 990, y 196-216: invisible and intangible until the player's rising head sweep (velocity.y < -50) strikes it; on hit it pays +5 coins, shows a 5-second Easter-egg toast, and becomes a solid, faintly-visible spent block.
One 'grumbler' patrols x 1620-1700 at 55 px/s, turning at each endpoint (constant speed, no chasing); brown blob with white eyes and angry brows drawn at ground level y=310; Area2D 24x20 collider.
Falling onto the grumbler (downward speed > 40 px/s, player above the enemy's top) kills it and bounces the player upward (-240 px/s); the run continues. Stomping awards no coins.
Touching a live grumbler from the side or while not falling kills the player: death card reads 'Squashed by a grumbler' and the attempt auto-restarts.

3 spike beds with triangular trigger silhouettes sized to each bed: 24px at x=320 (original yard), 40px at x=1216 (between the pipes), 64px at x=1760 (guarding the finish). Any contact kills with reason 'Watch the spikes'.

description: Falling below fall_y (430) kills the player with the death reason 'Missed the landing'.
On death the run freezes and a card shows the cause ('Watch the spikes' / 'Missed the landing' / 'Squashed by a grumbler') plus 'Back at the start in a moment.'; no button is needed.
0.55 seconds after death the attempt restarts automatically at spawn with coins, blocks, easter egg, and the grumbler reset; the death counter increments.

R restarts the current attempt in PLAYING, PAUSED, or DYING states. On the completion card, ENTER starts a fresh run (deaths reset to 0). M returns to the main menu from PAUSED or COMPLETE; ENTER or the button starts again from MENU.

Esc or P toggles pause; losing window focus auto-pauses (not in test mode). The pause card offers R (restart attempt) and M (main menu); resuming discards any jump pressed during the pause (require_jump_release), and the run timer stops.
Touching the finish flag area (x 1884-1908) ends the run: state COMPLETE, run time frozen, completion card shows time / retries / coins / rank, ENTER or PLAY AGAIN restarts.

Completion card ranks the coin haul: >= coins_total (23) 'PERFECT - every coin!', >= 24 'Coin master.', >= 15 'Solid haul.', else 'Coins left behind.' Known quirks: 'Coin master.' is unreachable (any total >= 24 also satisfies >= 23, so PERFECT fires first); PERFECT can trigger without all 23 world coins because bonked payouts (+1 per block, +5 egg) count toward the same total. Observed: 20 coins -> 'Solid haul.'

HUD (640x360 fixed, drawn over the world): title 'WALKER / JUMPMAN' + 'FIRST STEPS', controls line, live 'COINS nn/23' counter, width-aware progress bar from spawn to finish, footer 'No lives. Just another try.' with RETRIES count and run timer.
2 vertical pipe solids (32x40, teal top rim) at x 1184 and x 1256, flanking the 40px spike bed: hop across the rims with spikes between them.
4-step staircase (x 1312-1440, rising from y=304 to y=256) leading to a 96x16 high platform at y=256; the platform ends in a drop gap (x 1536-1584) that is safe to run off.

Jumpable pits: tutorial-yard gaps (64px at x 448-512, 48px at x 736-784), extension gap (64px at x 1088-1152, after the question blocks), and the platform drop (x 1536-1584, safe run-off). Missing a jump falls to the fall boundary.

Question blocks are bonked by striking them from below with the player's head (is_on_ceiling + head-rect overlap); the hidden Easter-egg block is struck by a taller upward head sweep because it is intangible until found. Block code lives in session, not a blocks feature folder.
Moving platforms: GDD MECH-05 explicitly defers them as a follow-up ('after level 1 ships'); starter GDD deferred them too. No moving-platform code exists in session.gd or the level JSON.

Ordered task stations (features/tasks/task_station.gd proposed) where touching the next-due station completes it and the HUD ledger ticks: design intent from Iteration 1, explicitly 'future work' in AGENTS.md. Not present in code or JSON.
